verdict.rationale: Unreal documents its own automation tooling: Python editor scripting removes repetitive tasks, Unreal Automation Tool automates testing and building, and commandlets such as -run=cook run from the command line. The only built-in recurring trigger is smoke tests that run every time the Editor, game, or commandlet starts. Nothing shows a user setting up automations that schedule themselves or run autonomously in the background; each documented action is a one-off invocation unless an external scheduler or CI drives it. Missing for 10: a built-in scheduler or trigger system for user-defined automations, documented background or unattended execution of arbitrary automations, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
